In Texas, your estate goes through something called intestate succession, which basically means the state decides who gets your assets. Your kids, spouse, or parents might inherit, but probably not in the way you'd want.

Without a will, your family could face months of court proceedings, increased legal fees, and unnecessary stress during an already difficult time. Plus, if you have minor children, a judge will decide who raises them, not you.
